The '''Republic Command Center''' was the command building within the [[Tokare Garrison]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] around [[3628 BBY]]. The command center was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] leadership to coordinate the operations against the Imperial soldiers and [[Nova Blades]] during the [[Dantooine Incursion]].<ref name="Marauders" />
